# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)
- **数据绑定**: [data-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/data-binding.md)
- **列表渲染 (wx:for)**: [list-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/list-render.md)
- **条件渲染 (wx:if)**: [conditional-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/conditional-render.md)
- **事件处理**: [event.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/event.md)
- **样式处理 (CSS)**: [css.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/css.md)
- **Class 与 Style 绑定**: [class-style-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/class-style-binding.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。
- **响应式原理**: [reactive.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/reactive.md) - 包含 watch, computed 等。
- **双向绑定**: [two-way-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/two-way-binding.md) - wx:model 语法。
- **引用 (Refs)**: [refs.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/refs.md)

## 6. 其他
- **生命周期**: [lifecycle.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/lifecycle.md)

<template>
  <view
    class="feed-page"
    bindtouchstart="onTouchStart"
    bindtouchmove="onTouchMove"
    bindtouchend="onTouchEnd"
    bindtouchcancel="onTouchEnd"
  >
    <view class="feed-content">
      <view class="categories">
        <text
          wx:for="{{categories}}"
          wx:key="id"
          class="category {{item.id === activeCategoryId ? 'category-active' : ''}}"
          data-category-id="{{item.id}}"
          bindtap="selectCategory"
        >{{item.name}}</text>
      </view>

      <view wx:for="{{products}}" wx:key="id" class="product">
        <image
          class="product-image"
          src="{{item.image}}"
          mode="widthFix"
          bindload="onImageLoad"
        />
        <product-video wx:if="{{item.video}}" product="{{item}}" />
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="fixed-cart" bindtap="openCart">购物车 {{cartCount}}</view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    categories: [],
    products: [],
    activeCategoryId: '',
    cartCount: 2,
    imagesLoaded: 0,
    dragging: false
  },
  async onLoad () {
    const { data } = await mpx.request({ url: '/api/feed' })
    this.categories = data.categories || []
    this.products = data.products || []
    if (this.categories.length) this.activeCategoryId = this.categories[0].id
  },
  methods: {
    selectCategory (event) {
      this.activeCategoryId = event.currentTarget.dataset.categoryId
    },
    onImageLoad () {
      // Keep this reactive so Web recalculates the natural document layout
      // after images that arrive after the feed request.
      this.imagesLoaded += 1
    },
    onTouchStart (event) {
      const touch = event.touches && event.touches[0]
      if (!touch) return
      this.touchStartX = touch.clientX
      this.touchStartY = touch.clientY
      this.dragging = true
    },
    onTouchMove (event) {
      if (!this.dragging) return
      const touch = event.touches && event.touches[0]
      if (!touch) return
      this.touchDeltaX = touch.clientX - this.touchStartX
      this.touchDeltaY = touch.clientY - this.touchStartY
    },
    onTouchEnd () {
      if (!this.dragging) return
      const deltaX = this.touchDeltaX || 0
      const deltaY = this.touchDeltaY || 0
      this.dragging = false
      this.touchDeltaX = 0
      this.touchDeltaY = 0
      if (Math.abs(deltaX) < 48 || Math.abs(deltaX) <= Math.abs(deltaY)) return

      const currentIndex = this.categories.findIndex(item => item.id === this.activeCategoryId)
      const nextIndex = currentIndex + (deltaX < 0 ? 1 : -1)
      if (nextIndex >= 0 && nextIndex < this.categories.length) {
        this.activeCategoryId = this.categories[nextIndex].id
      }
    },
    openCart () {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/cart/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "usingComponents": {
    "product-video": "../../components/product-video"
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.feed-page { min-height: 100vh; padding-bottom: 136rpx; }
.feed-content { min-height: 100vh; }

  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  display: flex;
  overflow-x: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: #fff;
}
.category { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 28rpx 24rpx; color: #666; }
.category-active { color: #111; font-weight: 600; }
.product { padding: 24rpx; }
.product-image { display: block; width: 100%; }
.fixed-cart {
  position: fixed;
  right: 24rpx;
  bottom: 40rpx;

  padding: 20rpx 28rpx;
  border-radius: 999rpx;
  background: #111;
  color: #fff;
}

<template>
  <view class="product-video" bindtap="onVideoTap">
    <video
      id="product-video"
      class="product-video-player"
      src="{{product.video}}"
      autoplay
      muted
      playsinline
      controls
      bindtimeupdate="onTimeUpdate"
      bindloadedmetadata="onLoadedMetadata"
      bindplay="onPlay"
      binderror="onVideoError"
    />
    <text>{{progress}} / {{duration}}</text>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    product: { type: Object, value: () => ({}) }
  },
  data: {
    progress: 0,
    duration: 0
  },
  methods: {
    onTimeUpdate (event) {
      this.progress = event.detail.currentTime
      this.duration = event.detail.duration
    },
    onLoadedMetadata (event) {
      this.videoSize = `${event.detail.width}x${event.detail.height}`
      this.duration = event.detail.duration || this.duration
    },
    onVideoTap () {
      // A tap supplies the user gesture required by Web when autoplay is blocked.
      const context = mpx.createVideoContext('product-video', this)
      if (context && context.play) context.play()
    },
    onPlay () {},
    onVideoError () {}
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.product-video { width: 100%; }
.product-video-player { display: block; width: 100%; }
</style>
